# Name Register

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NameRegister`](gmeow-NameRegister.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NameRegister>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The social register of a name-usage (formal, intimate, professional, casual) — the naming specialization of the [`gmeow:Register`](gmeow-Register.md) umbrella: a name register IS a register, so persona expression and name address draw from one vocabulary spine. A value vocabulary carried by [`gmeow:usageRegister`](../properties/gmeow-usageRegister.md) on a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Register`](gmeow-Register.md), [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NameRegister`](gmeow-NameRegister.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Register`](gmeow-Register.md), [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Register`](gmeow-Register.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the social register of a name-usage — referenced from [`gmeow:usageRegister`](../properties/gmeow-usageRegister.md) on a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) to mark a name as formal, intimate, professional, or casual.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a [`NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) subclass per register (registers are individuals) and avoid conflating register with the gender/identity axes — register is a posture of address, not an identity claim.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`NameRegister`](gmeow-NameRegister.md) individual from [`gmeow:usageRegister`](../properties/gmeow-usageRegister.md); extend the vocabulary with a new individual under [`gmeow:NameRegister`](gmeow-NameRegister.md) (it specializes [`gmeow:Register`](gmeow-Register.md)) rather than a subclass.

### Examples

- ex:usage [`gmeow:usageRegister`](../properties/gmeow-usageRegister.md) [`gmeow:registerFormal`](../individuals/gmeow-registerFormal.md).
